_comment: Every photo on the site. `file` is under media/original (own) or media/supplied (supplied). `living` places the steam (R) and gloss (G) masks as ellipses [cx, cy, rx, ry] in 0..1, top-left origin; `shimmer` adds heat haze. `illustrative` shows the Symbolbild label until the owner confirms the photo shows Oliveira's food.
